limitations: Independent 1.024 ms snapshots with unsampled upload gaps; no absolute detector rate.
Quiet-window RMS selects 16 us windows with range below 100 ADC codes and removes each window mean. This can suppress slow drift and exclude noise outliers.
Voltages assume a nominal 3.3 V ADC reference, not a measured reference.
Half-height width is counted on 0.25 us samples, not an analog bandwidth measurement.
The illustrative amplitude band scales the prior 60..100-code range by the supplied nominal gain ratio; it does not tag photopeak events or establish measured gain.
Changing the trigger threshold does not rescale the firmware baseline-noise/drift quality cuts.
Diagnostic sampling CPU load differs from normal histogram processing.
No resolution fit, energy calibration or proof against out-of-band oscillation.
